children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, climb further as markets wait for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole symposium at 1400 GMT. "We think it is unlikely we will hear much about interest rates from the Fed Chair, given his stated desire to eschew forward guidance," RBC BlueBay Asset Management's Mark Dowding says in a note. Ten-year gilt yields climb 3.2 basis points to last trade at 5.059%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
